scope: First real-market comparison; fixed before inferential analysis; old simulation packages unchanged

model.calibration: For each fixed rho, match H1 mean volume, volume variance and return variance by solving for q,u,lambda. No rho is selected, and these are not real-network estimates.

tail_rule: Fit continuous conditional tail models on H1, assess conditional log scores and fixed-model calibration on H2. Model returns are discrete and are only compared by empirical CCDF, never by continuous likelihood.
seasonality: H1 median profiles by 288 UTC time-of-day slots; freeze and apply to H2. Report raw and adjusted coupling/magnitude ACF.
impact: Fit r=kappa*(2*taker_buy_base-volume), through origin on H1. Evaluate same-bar association on H2; it is not a trading forecast or a causal estimate.
network_free_check: Delta=[Cov(r^2,V)/Var(r)-kappa3(V)/Var(V)]/E[V] must lie in (0,1] under the common-action interface, regardless of graph distribution and unknown N,u,lambda. Use day-block uncertainty and monthly/leave-extreme-day sensitivity.
statistics: Market intervals resample days in circular 1/7-day blocks; model summaries use 10 independent paths conditional on H1 calibration. No iid p-values for market tails. Fixed-H1 tail calibration uses a recentered block empirical-process bootstrap; approximate and conditional, not a test of every power-law family.
publication: Attribute Binance Vision; market-derived outputs CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 as stated in retrieved terms. Complete raw/processed market archives remain local.
